quotes.text: Berry was a budding studio genius, starting raw with doo-wop bands but eventually teaming with Dean Torrence. They fell into the company of Wilson and the result was the surf-pop classic "Surf City." They would stay with that sound for a long stretch, but Berry wanted to expand his creativity a little further.
Essentially a solo album, but credited to Jan & Dean contractually (with Torrence's blessing,) Carnival of Sound is finally available from the mischievous shoe-making elves at Rhino Handmade.
you can hear in the stereo mixes how people could come to the conclusion that Berry was another studio wizard.
The stereo mixes follow after and, sonically, blow the monos out of the water.
